QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] Unavoidable Fate
QuestInfo.0: You told Athena Pierce about Ellin's discovery. She looks utterly shocked, and for good reason.
QuestInfo.1: Perzen appeared while you were talking with Athena Pierce. See what he has to say.
QuestInfo.2: Everything that Ellin said was true. For the sake of all living things on Victoria Island, you must eliminate the fairies.

0.0: Then...what I saw back then was...
0.1: No...that's impossible. Fairies have little love for humans, but they have no reason to join forces with the Black Mage.
0.2: I'll need a proof. As a fairy myself, I can't belive such an accusation so easily.

no.0: Does it really make sense that Ephenia, the lady of the forest, has joined the Black Mage?

1.0: Lady Athena Pierce, you have noticed that Ephenia has changed as well, yes? Please...do not deny your feelings.
1.1: You already knew that the poison was spreading from the Fairy Forest, didn't you? Morever, Jackie's story from her escape matches what Ellin said.
1.2: I'm not the greatest prophet, but my prophecy also matches the current situation...\nIt's time to make a decision. If you cannot do this, I'll have to take a stand.

npc.0: Do you really think Epinea joined the Black Mage...?
